Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_process_code_desc
 from fr_master_codes
 where code = :process_code and
 code_type = 'PROC' and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1207');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting process code');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

declare

declare

--HCL select code_desc, expiry_date

 from components, valid_abo_values --HCL

--HCL master_codes.code(+) and

--HCL code_type(+) = 'ABO' and

 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 component_sp.product_code =
 components.product_code and
 component_sp.component_prefix =
 components.component_prefix and
 process_code = :process_code and
 sysdate between insert_dats and
 trunc(insert_dats)+365);

begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select product_desc
 into :s_product_code_desc
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5) and --HCL

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :diff_id is null
 then
 begin
 select differential_seq.nextval into :diff_id from dual;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from sequence');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into component_diff_hdr
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,
 component_prefix, process_code, stage_code,
 ext_int_flag, insert_dats, insert_user_id,
 differential_id)
 values(:unit_id, :coll_date, :s_chapter_id, :product_code,
 :component_prefix, :process_code, :stage_code,
 'Y', sysdate, :banner.user_id, :diff_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in component_diff_hdr');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 :differential_id := :diff_id;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;

 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then

 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end if;
end;
